title: Controlling Animation Queues
subtopics: Preventing repeated interactions from accumulating animations
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of controlling animation queues in a jQuery application.
Apply understanding effect queues in a small example and describe its expected result.
Verify .stop() with an explicit test or browser observation.
status_note: Draft generated from the attached syllabus and official references; requires lesson-by-lesson technical review, local execution, accessibility checks, and editorial approval.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through controlling animation queues with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns understanding effect queues into a repeatable implementation choice. Built-in effects and .animate() can reveal state changes, but effects should not block interaction or ignore reduced-motion preferences. Prefer CSS transitions for simple visual changes.
